correctness.rationale: The exact finite rooted-plane-tree count follows by Lagrange inversion on T=z(u+T/(1-T)); row-ratio identities prove strict TP2 on all positive four-cell minors with zero-cell boundaries checked. Strict conditional stochastic order follows because successive support intervals shift right, and covariance positivity follows by symmetrization. Differentiated generating functions and Narayana moments yield covariance (m-1)/(m+2) and stated correlation. A separate tree-shape enumerator and rational checker passed 15,911 assertions through m=100; finite tests are auxiliary to the complete symbolic proof.

value.rationale: A finite-size TP2 theorem in a canonical Catalan tree model governs every increasing function of global leaf count given local root degree, not merely a scalar correlation. It is an exact structural dependence law with meaningful strictness/zero-support boundaries, and exact covariance remains positive despite decorrelation at rate m^{-1/2}. The theorem identifies an interpretable example of stochastic dependence hidden by weak linear correlation.
